verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a Draft Option Grant API for grants that have not yet received board consent and approval [carta-docs-22]. It also shows retrieval of fair market values derived from the issuer's 409A valuations [carta-docs-23], plus option grant listing [carta-docs-20, carta-docs-10]. Together these imply the building blocks of the story, but nothing documents the board approval flow itself or an automatic link between the 409A value and the strike price as one end-to-end founder workflow. Missing for 10: a documented board consent/approval workflow, strike price set automatically from the current 409A, a single end-to-end issuance flow from offer to executed grant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
